---
title: "Puissance et niveau des tests d'adéqutaion aux tests d'adéquation à la loi gamma i.i.d"
author: "TITO A. Rytrace"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: pdf_document
---



```{r}
# x : vecteur d'observations i.i.d. (données positives)
# B : nombre de réplications bootstrap

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Estimation des paramètres (Villaseñor‑González)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
estimer_params_VG <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x)  
  log_x <- log(x)
  ml <- mean(log_x)
  b_hat <- mean((x - m) * (log_x - ml))
  if (b_hat <= 0) b_hat <- 1e-6
  a_hat <- m / b_hat
  if (a_hat <= 0) a_hat <- 1e-6
  c(shape = a_hat, rate = 1 / b_hat)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test de Henze 
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
gof.henze <- function(x, B = 50) {
  if (!requireNamespace("gofgamma", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("gofgamma")
  library(gofgamma)
  test.HME1(x, a = 1, boot = B, alpha = 0.05)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test VGE 
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
gof.vge <- function(x, B = 50) {
  if (!requireNamespace("goft", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("goft")
  library(goft)
  params <- estimer_params_VG(x)
  shape <- params["shape"]
  rate  <- params["rate"]
  T_obs <- abs(suppressWarnings(gamma_test(x)$statistic))
  T_boot <- replicate(B, {
    x_star <- rgamma(length(x), shape = shape, rate = rate)
    tryCatch(abs(suppressWarnings(gamma_test(x_star)$statistic)),
             error = function(e) NA)
  })
  p_val <- mean(T_boot >= T_obs, na.rm = TRUE)
  list(statistic = T_obs, p.value = p_val, method = "Bootstrap VGE (VG)")
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test KS 
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
gof.ks <- function(x, B = 50) {
  params <- estimer_params_VG(x)
  shape <- params["shape"]
  rate  <- params["rate"]
  D_obs <- suppressWarnings(
    ks.test(x, "pgamma", shape = shape, rate = rate)$statistic
  )
  D_boot <- replicate(B, {
    x_star <- rgamma(length(x), shape = shape, rate = rate)
    tryCatch({
      p_star <- estimer_params_VG(x_star)
      ks.test(x_star, "pgamma", shape = p_star["shape"], rate = p_star["rate"])$statistic
    }, error = function(e) NA)
  })
  p_val <- mean(D_boot >= D_obs, na.rm = TRUE)
  structure(list(statistic = D_obs, p.value = p_val,
                 method = "KS with parametric bootstrap (VG)",
                 data.name = deparse(substitute(x))), class = "htest")
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test de Betsch & Ebner 
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
gof.betsch <- function(x, B = 50) {
  if (!requireNamespace("gofgamma", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("gofgamma")
  library(gofgamma)
  test.BE(x, boot = B)
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fonction principale : gof.gamma.iid
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
gof.gamma.iid <- function(x, test) {
  switch(test,
         Henze = gof.henze(x),
         VGE   = gof.vge(x),
         KS    = gof.ks(x),
         BET   = gof.betsch(x),
         stop("Test inconnu. Choisir parmi 'Henze', 'VGE', 'KS', 'BET'"))
}
```


# Niveau et puissance des tests  

```{r}
MC_test <- function(n, R, alpha, rgen) {
  # n     : taille de chaque échantillon
  # R     : nombre de répétitions
  # alpha : seuil de signification
  # rgen  : fonction générant un échantillon de taille n
  # Retourne un vecteur nommé des taux de rejet pour les quatre tests
  
  tests <- c("Henze", "VGE", "KS", "BET")
  rejet <- setNames(rep(0, length(tests)), tests)
  
  for (i in 1:R) {
    x <- rgen(n)
    for (t in tests) {
      res <- gof.gamma.iid(x, t)
      if (t %in% c("Henze", "BET")) {
        if (res$Decision) rejet[t] <- rejet[t] + 1
      } else {
        if (res$p.value < alpha) rejet[t] <- rejet[t] + 1
      }
    }
  }
  rejet / R
}
```


# Niveau des tests (H0 vraie)

```{r}
# Sous H0 : loi gamma(2,1)
rgen_gamma <- function(n) rgamma(n, shape = 2, rate = 1)
niveau <- MC_test(n = 100, R = 500, alpha = 0.05, rgen = rgen_gamma)
print(niveau)

```


# Puissance sous une alternative (loi log‑normale)

```{r}
# Sous H1 : loi log‑normale
rgen_lnorm <- function(n) rlnorm(n, meanlog = 0, sdlog = 0.5)
puissance_lnorm <- MC_test(n = 100, R = 200, alpha = 0.05, rgen = rgen_lnorm)
print(puissance_lnorm)
```

# Puissance sous une alternative (loi de Weibull)

```{r}
# Sous H1 : loi de Weibull 
rgen_weibull <- function(n) rweibull(n, shape = 2, scale = 1)
puissance_weibull <- MC_test(n = 100, R = 200, alpha = 0.05, rgen = rgen_weibull)
print(puissance_weibull)

```

# Puissance sous une alternative (loi Normale)

```{r}
rgen_normale <- function(n, mu = 5, sigma = 1) {
  # Vérification que la condition est satisfaite
  if (mu - 4 * sigma^2 <= 0) stop("mu - 4*sigma^2 doit être > 0")
  rnorm(n, mean = mu, sd = sigma)
}

puissance_normale <- MC_test(100, R = 500, alpha = 0.05, function(n) rgen_normale(n, 5, 1))

print(puissance_normale)

```
